facts.condition: For decoder-exchange-symmetric finite channels, the accepted UV scalar decomposes across channel factors; consequently, applying that scalar to multiple canonical BSSC uses cannot tighten its normalized one-use converse.

assumptions: The UV scalar is interpreted only in the separately relaxed, decoder-symmetric scope accepted by the cited claim.
No conclusion is assumed for coupled auxiliary optimizations, nonsymmetric channels, richer converse systems, or the exact sum-capacity.
